title: Character reference sheet (front, side, back)

comfyui.note: Uses only built-in ComfyUI nodes (plus the custom node listed, if any). Update ComfyUI if a node shows red.

inputs.default: character sheet, multiple views, front view, side view, back view, full body, a-pose, simple white background, 1girl, silver hair, teal eyes, oversized hoodie, sneakers, masterpiece, best quality

forWhat: Front, side and back views of an original character, to model from or to paint textures with.
output: One wide sheet, 2048x1024 PNG, plain background.
vtp: Use it as the reference for the texture repaint workflow and for your model maker.
ask: Set up the VTube Pro character sheet workflow in ComfyUI
steps: Describe your character in "Your prompt": hair, eyes, outfit, colours.
Press Run a few times and keep the most consistent sheet.
tips: Original designs only: no existing characters, logos or game outfits.
A neutral A-pose and even light make modelling easier.
licenceSummary: Commercial use OK by default: CreativeML Open RAIL++-M, BSD-3-Clause.
